Add a "no data" key for NA regions

Source: R/scales.R
lap_na_guide.Rd

ggplot2's colour-bar and colour-steps guides do not show an NA entry. Add + lap_na_guide() after a scale_lapidary scale to draw a single swatch (an invisible layer on the unused shape aesthetic) for the na.value colour - e.g. hexagons with no wells.

Usage

lap_na_guide(
  label = lap_tr("no_data"),
  colour = NULL,
  variant = NULL,
  order = 2
)

Arguments

label

Key label. Defaults to the localised "no data".

colour

Swatch colour. NULL (default) uses the variant's token missing colour (matches the scale's na.value).

variant

"light" / "dark". Defaults to lap_variant().

order

Legend order (passed to ggplot2::guide_legend()); the default 2 keeps the NA key below a lap_coloursteps_guide() bar (order 1).

Value

A list of ggplot2 layers/scales to add to a plot with +.

See also

scale_lapidary

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(ggplot2)
data(germany_hex_sample, package = "lapidary")
ggplot(germany_hex_sample) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_gwl)) +
  scale_fill_lapidary_c("magnitude") +
  lap_na_guide()
} # }
